text: Appeal of Order to Comply (October 27, 2017) for 599 Kennedy Road.

Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the order to comply, dated November 15, 2017, for 599 Kennedy Road, Folder No: 17 254513 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to June 8, 2018, to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
